assumptions.cond: Whenever state_sel is used in the data path.
assumptions.risk: An illegal value could select an invalid state, causing cipher rounds to be skipped or wrong data to be processed, potentially leaking secret key material.

assumptions.claim: add_rk_sel_raw must carry a legal add_rk_sel_e enum value.

assumptions.claim: key_full_sel_raw must carry a legal key_full_sel_e enum value.

assumptions.claim: key_dec_sel_raw must carry a legal key_dec_sel_e enum value.
assumptions.cond: When key decryption logic is instantiated.

assumptions.risk: Wrong key words may be mixed into the cipher state, causing data corruption.
